description: This is an abstract base test class for persistence actors related to policy management in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes constants for policies, subjects, resources, and setup methods for test environments using Akka, JUnit, and related frameworks.

classes.name: PersistenceActorTestBase
classes.description: Base test class for testing persistence actors of the policies persistence component. Provides setup, teardown, and helper methods for unit tests involving policy objects, headers, and Akka actor systems.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes static test configuration and policy configuration from the 'test' config file.

methods.name: createDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates DittoHeaders with specified JSON schema version and authorization subjects.

methods.name: createPolicyWithRandomId
methods.description: Creates a new Policy object with a randomly generated identifier.

methods.name: createPolicyWithId
methods.description: Creates a new Policy object with a specified policy name.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment with a custom configuration.

methods.name: setUpBase
methods.description: Initializes the test environment using default 'test' configuration.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Creates an ActorSystem, initializes test probes, and sets up default headers for testing.

methods.name: tearDownBase
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after tests complete.

methods.name: disableLogging
methods.description: Disables logging for the test actor system to reduce verbosity.
